question: Migration 0042 renames user_id to account_id across the v2 response models to match the new tenancy naming. Proceed with the rename in the v2 schema, or keep user_id?

options.label: Rename to account_id

options.label: Keep user_id
options.description: Same field name as v1; SDKs and integrations keep working unchanged.

context: The schema-migrator subagent is regenerating the v2 OpenAPI spec. Six agents (SDK, docs, examples, two test suites, changelog) are waiting on the final field names.

question: Webhook payloads still use `created`. Rename it to `created_at` for consistency with the rest of v2?

options.description: Consistent with every other v2 timestamp.

options.label: Keep created

question: Settings page redesign: tabs (one section at a time) or a single scrolling page with a sticky section nav? Both are built far enough to click through.

options.label: One page
options.description: Everything on one scrolling page with a sticky nav; easier to scan, longer page.

context: The settings-ui subagent built both variants on preview branches. Usage data: 70% of settings visits go to API keys; the rest are spread evenly.

options.label: Hand-write validators

question: The bulk-export endpoint is a week behind. Push the v2 launch a week, or launch on time without bulk export?

options.label: 5,000 a day
